note: Hypothesis-level necessary conditions; no fitted material property and no candidate success probabilities.

retention.note: Circular platelet projection; uniform pressure and interface strength; peel, bending, defects and roughness excluded. Rim area=pi*D*e; backside area=beta*pi*D^2/4.

impact.note: Tip speed cited from S1 Table5-3; collision speed, coupling, branch model and elastic limit are assumptions. Energy comparison is neither fracture prediction nor fatigue life.

finite_motion.note: Single forward stroke with no reset. Optimistic fraction of travel with zero friction; not whole-cycle energy proof.

cost.note: Unquoted marginal material costs. Holding phase chemistry, fabrication equipment and extra processing remain unchosen/unpriced. Patent ratios are not recommended ski composition.

source_kinematics.note: S3 eq2.1 gives |D|*omega but supplied D=30mm would give63mm/s. Half-stroke interpretation gives31.5mm/s. Retain discrepancy, do not silently correct source.
